newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia's IFI sets 10-yr $150 mln Eurobond.
newsitem.headline: Colombia's IFI sets 10-yr $150 mln Eurobond.

text.p: The head of Colombia's Instituto de Fomento Industrial (IFI) said the state-run development institute plans to issue a 10-year $150 million Eurobond in June to help provide additional credits for local business and industry.

Gabriel Borrero, IFI's president, told Reuters no lead managers had been selected for the debt issue yet. But he said it was part of a three-year program under which IFI would issue a total of $400 million in Eurobonds.
The industrial development institute sold $125 million in debt on European markets last year and plans an additional $125 million Eurobond issue in 1998, Borrero said.
